fact: Sierra Leone's National Revenue Authority is rolling out the NTR Payment Mobile App to digitise non-tax service fee payments, with training in the southern and eastern regions done and the current phase covering Port Loko, Makeni, Karene, Kono, Kambia and Falaba.
Bo District Council says it launched the GovPay Sierra Leone e-money application on 24 April 2025 so that property rates can be paid electronically by mobile money.
